children: AvenuesAI Ltd (formerly known as Infibeam Avenues), a multinational financial technology and AI infrastructure company headquartered in GIFT City, reported a six per cent rise in net profit in the September quarter to ₹72 crore while revenue increased 47 per cent year-on-year to ₹2,879 crore, on the back of growing demand.

The company’s operating performance was supported by growth in its payments business and expansion across digital financial services, even as competition in the payments market put pressure on transaction margins.

For the first half of FY27, revenue from operations increased 71 per cent to ₹5,560 crore, while profit after tax grew 24 per cent to ₹156 crore. Operating EBITDA, excluding other income, stood at ₹199 crore, registering a 19 per cent year-on-year growth.

CCAvenue, the company’s flagship payment gateway business, continued to drive transaction volumes. Its payment processing value increased 19 per cent sequentially to around ₹1.77 lakh crore during the September quarter. However, the net take rate moderated to 5.06 basis points, reflecting pricing pressure and heightened competition in the payments industry.
Vishwas Patel, Managing Director and CEO, AvenuesAI, said the company was focusing on expanding its offerings beyond payment processing to deepen relationships with merchants and enterprises.
The company is also integrating Rediff.com into its digital ecosystem, with RediffOne targeting enterprise communication and digital services and RediffPay focusing on consumer payments.
International expansion of CCAvenue, particularly in the US, UAE, Saudi Arabia and Australia, is another growth priority.
AvenuesAI is also developing TISco, its AI-led transaction intelligence platform, to offer solutions in fraud detection, risk assessment and merchant intelligence.

The company is seeking to evolve from a payments-led business into a broader AI-first fintech platform, with technology-led services expected to support revenue diversification and improve margins over the longer term.

title: AvenuesAI Q2 profit climbs 6% to ₹72 crore on higher demand
